subject: IF directive
notes: SR1 (cite.py --check 7.3.16.3 OK): '>>IF conditional-expression-1 shall begin on a new line and shall be specified entirely on that line.' Render recognizes a directive only when the TRIMMED line starts with '>>' (begin on a new line; §7.3.3 SR2 allows leading spaces); the cce is exactly the operand of that one line, fragment-parsed by DirectiveExpressionFragment.ParseCce. Probe p16: 'DISPLAY "A" >>IF V = 1' mid-line -> COBOL0307 (rejected). p17: '>>IF V =' with '1' on the next line -> COBOL1619 malformed 'V =' (rejected, the cce is not continued onto the next line). Both halves verified. No spec-derived negative test located. || editions (adjudicator): 2002, 2014, 2023 (the §7.3 compiler-directive facility, incl. conditional compilation, is absent from COBOL-85; the pinned compiler gates >>IF at --std 85 with COBOL0900, probe p01)
